name: Koiyasumi Encore! ~Lovely Golden Week~
original_name: コイヤスミEncore！～ラブリーゴールデンウィーク～
source:
Four months have passed since that winter vacation... Now, Hiroki was watching Usaki in her swimsuit frolicking in the heated pool of a resort hotel. It's Golden Week! 

The main character, Hiroki Izumo, has come to a northern resort with his childhood friend and now girlfriend, Usaki Inaba. He invites her on a vacation as a reward for her hard work on her exams. 

The two of them are excited about their first trip together. They enjoyed the resort pool, the private bath, the lavender field, and the fact that the two of them make love anytime, anywhere! 

Lovely Golden Week, let's go now!

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/recreation/koiyasumi-ec/gw.html]official site[/url]]
